newsitem.title: POLAND: SGZ to buy 2-3 pct of Polish co-op bank.
newsitem.headline: SGZ to buy 2-3 pct of Polish co-op bank.

text.p: Germany's Suedwestdeutsche Genossenschaft Zentralbank AG (SGZ) is likely to buy up to 700,000-zlotys worth of shares in a Polish small cooperative bank in 1997, a spokeswoman of the Polish bank said.
Ewa Ewertowska told Reuters on Wednesday that the purchase would give SGZ two to three percent in the Gospodarczy Bank Wielkopolski SA (GBW).
"SGZ-Bank wants to buy a new issue of 500,000 to 700,000 zlotys .... it will give it between two and three percent (in GBW)," she said.
She added the purchase had yet to be cleared by the Polish central bank.
GBW is owned by about 100 Polish cooperative banks from northwestern Poland.
